Extract multiple in-memory documents in one batch.

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val result = Xberg.extractBatch(listOf(mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":[72,101,108,108,111,44,32,119,111,114,108,100,33],\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/plain\"}", ExtractInput::class.java), mapper.readValue("{\"bytes\":\"html/html.html\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"text/html\"}", ExtractInput::class.java)), ExtractionConfig())
    println(result)
}
```
